title: 1975 NORAD report of UFOs over Malmstrom
place_text: Malmstrom Air Force Base missile sites, Montana

tellings.quote: you know, again in, uh, uh, 1975 at Malmstrom. Uh there is a NORAD report of UFO sight settings again over Melmstrom uh missile bases

plain: A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas says a 1975 report from NORAD, the North American air defence command, records UFO sightings over the nuclear missile sites of Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana. He raises it with Michels as another sign that UFOs kept appearing over these nuclear weapons, which, if true, would mean an ongoing interest in America's nuclear arsenal.
